narr: Widespread clusters of strong to severe thunderstorms, some with intense rainfall in a short period of time, developed during the early to mid afternoon hours. The thunderstorms moved slowly south to southwest, merging in some areas to produce very heavy rainfall. Excessive rainfall resulted in brief isolated flash flooding in Dekalb and Madison Counties. ||Flash Flooding in DeKalb.|Flash Flooding of Sparkman Drive in front of NSSTC.|Wind Damage.
ev: Flood water covered all of the southbound lanes of Sparkman Drive on the UAH campus. Estimated 6 inch depth in spots based on social media photo. Area notoriously known for poor drainage during heavy rainfall.
Corrects previous flood report from 4 NNE Pine Ridge. Road washed out at CR 27 and 494.
